capabilities.scope: Linux CO-RE loader, tracepoint attach, optional atomic Zenoh publish/callback and Linux raw-port syscall uprobe pairs, fixed event decode, privileged gateway, raw-port and synchronized process-leader-exit host qualifications, bounded scheduler runqueue and tracked-TID migration evidence, bounded IRQ/softirq duration evidence, bounded EtherType/ifindex skb drop windows, bounded tracked-process page-fault windows, bounded cpufreq policy-limit episodes, bounded request-correlated gateway and per-thread raw-port syscall duration evidence, leader-thread process-exit filtering, OOM victim-PID attribution and incident correlation

Process-exit evidence contains no exit code/signal, does not prove complete thread-group death, and does not qualify OOM, PID namespace/cgroup identity or restart supervision. Gateway evidence does not qualify a live Zenoh session, router/transport queue, IPC, serialization, permit or reconnect cause. Raw-port evidence does not qualify real AF_PACKET/NIC load or cycle/driver/NIC/wire/slave timing. Production target kernels, overhead/WCET, ROS2, recorder, scheduler migration and IRQ/softirq pressure, real NIC/page-fault/OOM/cpufreq-limit injection, migration-cause/affinity/cache-impact, major/minor fault attribution, OOM victim TGID resolution and instantaneous-frequency/residency/cause qualification remain open
